description: Canonical puzzle/solution catalog plus replay-backed fragment flow, transplantable geometry, observed transforms and assembly layout materialization for Opus Magnum Codex.

identity.canonicalStructuralHash: translation/rotation invariant hash preserving program timing
identity.canonicalMechanismHash: translation/rotation invariant hash with normalized program timing
identity.puzzleFeatureFingerprint: hash of solver-relevant puzzle chemistry, molecule topology, available parts and production constraints

fragmentIndex.purpose: Catalog reusable fragment mechanisms with representative canonical geometry.

fragmentFlowIndex.purpose: Catalog replay-observed transitions, convergence motifs and source-local relative transforms.

assemblyLayout.purpose: Materialize a convergence-aware assembly DAG into one axial coordinate frame.
assemblyLayout.root: convergence fragment anchored at position [0,0], rotation 0

propagation.branches: walk backwards from convergence inputs with inverse relative transforms
propagation.tail: walk forwards from convergence target with preferred transition transforms
propagation.fragmentGeometry: rotate/translate representative canonical geometry so its functional anchor matches the propagated placement

assemblyLayout.deduplication: identical part type/position/rotation/length/which/track/pipe geometry is retained once

diagnostics.missingTransforms: assembly edges lacking usable relative-transform evidence
diagnostics.conflicts: current first-pass detection of different part types sharing a part origin
diagnostics.layoutComplete: true only when no geometry or transform is missing

limitations: Origin-overlap detection is not full occupied-cell or swept-path collision detection.
Programs remain normalized per fragment and are not globally synchronized.
A materialized layout is not yet serialized as a .solution or validated by OMSim.

nextGenerationStep: synchronize fragment programs using observed transition cycle offsets
assign stable arm numbers and part ids
convert materialized parts into a writable parsed-solution model
iterate geometry/transform variants when validation fails
